abilities.name: Feishu

abilities.author: Astravia / Lark Suite

zh.name: 飞书
zh.description: 使用官方 lark-cli 及其内置 Skills 处理飞书文档、消息、日历、多维表格、任务等内容。

abilities.name: CLIProxyAPI

abilities.author: Astravia / Router For Me

zh.name: CLIProxyAPI
zh.description: 运行受管的本地模型网关，连接 Gemini CLI、Codex、Claude、Antigravity、Kimi 与 xAI 账号，并在 Astravia 中使用动态发现的模型。

abilities.name: Notion
abilities.description: Connect a Notion workspace with browser authorization, then search, read, create and update pages directly from Astravia.
abilities.author: Notion

zh.name: Notion
zh.description: 通过浏览器授权连接 Notion 工作区，之后可直接让 Astravia 搜索、读取、新建和更新页面。

abilities.name: Shimo
abilities.description: An immersive bilingual reading workspace for books, poetry and study notes in Astravia, with Shimo reading Skills shipped inside the reader plugin.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 拾墨
zh.description: 在 Astravia 中沉浸式阅读书籍与诗歌，划选内容即可提问、解析、标注拼音并保存阅读记录。

abilities.name: Cloudflare Developer Platform
abilities.description: Build, review, deploy and operate Cloudflare projects with official guidance, live documentation and optional account access.
abilities.author: Cloudflare / Astravia

zh.name: Cloudflare 开发平台
zh.description: 把官方平台知识、Wrangler 实践、Workers 审查、实时文档和可选账号授权组合起来，用 Astravia 开发并运维 Cloudflare 项目。

abilities.name: Spreadsheet Toolkit
abilities.description: Create, read, analyze, edit, repair and validate spreadsheets (.xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv) without format loss, with first-class Chinese/CJK support.

zh.name: 表格工具箱
zh.description: 创建、读取、分析、编辑与修复表格文件，保留透视表、宏、图表与格式，中文场景一等支持。

abilities.name: Word Document Toolkit
abilities.description: Create, edit, fill, reformat and convert Word documents with zero format loss via an OpenXML-level Python toolchain.

zh.name: Word 文档工具箱
zh.description: 在 OpenXML 层原地编辑 Word 文档，样式、页眉页脚、编号与修订原样保留，支持中文公文排版。

abilities.name: PDF Toolkit
abilities.description: Read, create and review PDFs where layout matters, verifying output by rendering pages instead of trusting the text layer.

zh.name: PDF 工具箱
zh.description: 读取、生成与审阅 PDF，通过渲染页面确认最终版式，而不是只看文本抽取结果。

abilities.name: Remotion Best Practices
abilities.description: Domain knowledge for building videos programmatically with Remotion: animation, sequencing, captions, audio, dynamic duration and rendering.

zh.name: Remotion 最佳实践
zh.description: 用 React/TypeScript 编写视频的领域知识：动画、镜头编排、字幕、音频、动态时长与渲染。

abilities.name: Resume Tailoring
abilities.description: Rewrite a resume against one specific job posting: reorder real experience, mirror the posting's keywords for ATS parsing, quantify what can be quantified, and name the gaps worth closing.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 简历定制
zh.description: 针对一个具体岗位改写简历：重排真实经历、对齐招聘方关键词以通过筛选系统、把能量化的成果量化，并说明还差什么。

abilities.name: Codebase Migration and Refactoring
abilities.description: Run a large migration or multi-file refactor through a tracked pipeline: measure the blast radius, apply AST codemods, open one pull request per batch, gate each batch on CI, and audit the dead config and leftover shims afterwards.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 代码库迁移与重构
zh.description: 把动辄上百个文件的框架升级或重构，按批次推进：一条精确变换规则、AST 改造、每批一个 PR、CI 绿了才继续，最后清掉迁移留下的死配置与临时兼容层。

abilities.name: Xiaohongshu Accounts
abilities.description: Manage multiple Xiaohongshu accounts and run built-in MCP tasks concurrently through the account selected for each task.
abilities.author: Astravia / xpzouying

zh.name: 小红书账号
zh.description: 在 Astravia 中管理多个小红书账号，Agent 可自动选择账号并同时执行内置 MCP 任务。

abilities.name: X API
abilities.description: Search X posts, users, trends and news through the official hosted X API MCP server.
abilities.author: X Developer Platform

zh.name: X API
zh.description: 通过官方托管的 X API MCP 服务搜索帖子、用户、趋势和新闻。

abilities.name: Zhihu Research
abilities.description: Ask Astravia to research Zhihu experiences and current discussions, compare viewpoints and return source links.
abilities.author: Astravia / Klarkxy

zh.name: 知乎调研
zh.description: 让 Astravia 帮你调研知乎口碑与热点讨论，整理不同观点，并附上可核查的来源链接。

abilities.name: Pelican Ride
abilities.description: A bicycle-riding pelican mini game in the activity panel. Chat with the AI to change its speed, make it jump, ring the bell or switch between day, dusk, night and rain.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 鹈鹕骑车
zh.description: 活动面板里骑自行车的鹈鹕小游戏。和 AI 对话即可调速度、让它跳跃、按铃铛，或切换白天、黄昏、天黑与下雨场景。

abilities.name: Build Apple Apps
abilities.description: Bring a live iOS Simulator into the activity panel so the AI can build, install, launch and operate your app, with a built-in SwiftUI development guide.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 构建 Apple App
zh.description: 把实时的 iOS 模拟器放进活动面板，让 AI 构建、安装、启动并操作你的 App，内置 SwiftUI 开发指南。

abilities.name: Web Element Picker
abilities.description: Open any webpage inside Astravia, click to pick elements, and generate structured context — CSS selectors, XPath, semantic paths, React component chains. Copy instantly or send straight to the AI for code changes.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 网页元素选择器
zh.description: 在 Astravia 内置浏览器中打开任意网页，点选元素并生成结构化上下文——选择器、XPath、语义路径、React 组件链。一键复制或发送给 AI 直接改代码。

abilities.name: dbx-pro Database Workbench
abilities.description: Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse and 100+ databases. Encrypted connection manager, multi-tab SQL editor, sortable result grid, write safety confirmation and query history. Turn any query result into filterable dashboards and big screens — 11 chart types, offline single-file export — and let AI read your database through MCP.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: dbx-pro 数据库工作台
zh.description: 直连 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse 等 100+ 种数据库。连接管理（密码加密）、多标签 SQL 编辑器、可排序结果表格、写操作安全确认与查询历史；把查询结果做成可筛选的看板与大屏，11 种图表、导出为断网可用的单文件 HTML，并让 AI 通过 MCP 直接读取数据库。

abilities.name: Free Model Gateway
abilities.description: Run a managed local gateway that reuses upstream free-model channels, syncs models into Astravia and ships a one-click UI for start/stop, logs and risk.
abilities.author: Astravia Community

zh.name: 免费模型网关
zh.description: 运行受管的本地网关，复用上游免费模型通道并同步模型到 Astravia，提供一键启停、日志与风险声明界面。

abilities.name: REA Reverse Engineering
abilities.description: Connect Astravia to REA so the agent can reverse engineer native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, firmware and website traffic — with evidence for every conclusion.
abilities.author: Astravia Community

zh.name: rea逆向工程
zh.description: 把 REA 接入 Astravia，让 Agent 逆向原生二进制、JavaScript 与 Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、固件以及网站流量——每条结论都附上证据与边界。

abilities.name: Video Downloader
abilities.description: Paste a video link and download the highest quality locally — 1000+ sites supported, with progress, a queue and a shortcut to the finished file. The engine sets itself up, so there is nothing to install.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 视频下载器
zh.description: 粘贴视频链接即可在本地下载最高画质，覆盖 1000+ 站点，支持进度、队列与直达文件夹；解析与合并组件会自动准备好，无需手动安装。

abilities.name: Hanshuang Pojia
abilities.description: Audit an APK, iOS package, ELF, PE or Mach-O file from the chat: permissions, exported components, embedded secrets, section entropy, symbol tables, byte-range disassembly and a 0-100 risk score.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 寒霜破甲
zh.description: 在对话里体检 APK、iOS 包、ELF、PE 或 Mach-O 文件：权限、导出组件、硬编码凭据、节区熵、符号表、区间反汇编与 0-100 风险评分。
